title: Existing total tensor interface and its canonical summand inclusions
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the module universe and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ for the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with its sheafified balanced tensor bifunctor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For integer cochain complexes $A,B$ of $R$-module sheaves, let $\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_R B)$ be the direct-sum total tensor of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], whose degree $n$ object is $\bigoplus_{p+q=n}A^p\otimes_R B^q$ and differential is $d_A\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_B$ on the $(p,q)$ summand. Define $\iota_{p,q,n}:A^p\otimes_R B^q\to\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_R B)^n$, for $p+q=n$, to be the canonical inclusion of this direct-sum summand. The named existing interface consists of this inclusion and transparent aliases for $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, its tensor bifunctor, and its total tensor bifunctor; complexes may be unbounded.
